newsitem.title: INDONESIA: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - Nov 28.
newsitem.headline: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - Nov 28.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Indonesian stocks on Thursday:
* The Dow Jones industrial average fell 29.07 points to 6,499.34 on Wednesday, its biggest loss so far in November, amid profit-taking before the Thanksgiving holiday.
* Telkom announced on Wednesday it posted a net profit of 1.13 trillion rupiah in the first nine months of 1996 against 878.4 billion rupiah in the same 1995 period.
* Indonesian courts ordered the release on Wednesday of all 124 supporters of opposition figure Megawati Sukarnoputri imprisoned since riots in July.

* The Jakarta composite index fell 5.96 points, or 0.95 percent, to end at 620.27 points on Wednesday on profit-taking as announcement of a rise in Telkom's nine-month net profit failed to boost sentiment.
* Brokers said the market was likely to move sideways on Thursday due to a lack of fresh leads, brokers said.
* On Thursday, the rupiah was quoted at 2,344.10/44.50 in early trading against the opening of 2,344.25/45.25.
* Telkom following announcement of a rise in its nine-month financial results and continued talk that the government may launch a secondary offering some time next year.
* Dharmala Intiland on reports it had signed an agreement with a Singaporean firm to build an industrial estate in East Java.

* Astra International on comments by five business tycoons together holding more than 50 percent of the company that they did not have any plans yet to change the automobile conglomerate's management and business lines.
